title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 00-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve notificar a Cummins dentro de 15 dias úteis após receber uma peça que exige análise por parte da base de fornecimento.
IT: The VCM must notify Cummins within a maximum of 20 working days after receiving the part that requires supply base analysis. This rule allows a longer deadline than the customer's strict 15-day requirement.
Analysis: The IT governs the same activity as the customer requirement: notifying Cummins about failure analysis of received components. Both involve the supplier (VCM) notifying Cummins after receiving a part requiring analysis. However, the IT allows up to 20 days, while the requirement mandates strict compliance within 15 days. The IT's rule is less stringent than the customer's specific deadline, creating a direct contradiction.
action: Update the IT to enforce a maximum of 15 working days for notifying Cummins, aligning with the customer's specific deadline.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 00-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve notificar a Cummins dentro de 15 dias úteis após receber uma peça que exige análise por parte da base de fornecimento.
IT: O QM deve notificar a Cummins após receber uma peça que exige análise por parte da base de fornecimento.
Analysis: 15-day deadline for notification
action: Update the IT to explicitly include the 15-day deadline for notifying Cummins after receiving a part requiring analysis by the supply base.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 02-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve conceder 15 dias úteis adicionais ao fornecedor da Cummins para realizar a análise de subfornecedor após notificação.
IT: O QM deve conceder um prazo adicional ao fornecedor da Cummins para realizar a análise de subfornecedor após notificação.
Analysis: Specific 15-day requirement (dias úteis) for the additional deadline
action: Update IT 02-PART to explicitly state 'grant an additional **15 dias úteis**' in the rule, aligning with the customer's specific deadline requirement.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 01-PART
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve utilizar o método Anova, conforme descrito na 4ª edição do MSA, como método preferencial para enviar análises dos sistemas de medição à Cummins.
IT: The IT rule states that QM must ensure analyses are sent regularly without specifying the method, which contradicts the customer requirement mandating the use of Anova per MSA 4th edition. The IT’s lack of specificity on the method violates the explicit mandate.
Analysis: Explicit specification of the Anova method and reference to MSA 4th edition in the procedure
action: Revise the IT to explicitly require the use of the Anova method as per MSA 4th edition, ensuring alignment with the customer requirement.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 03-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor pode ser solicitado a cumprir os requisitos de qualidade do padrão ISO-3834 referentes a soldas, se pertencer a determinados segmentos da Cummins Inc.
IT: The IT allows non-compliance with ISO-3834 welding requirements if technically justified and approved by PP, which contradicts the customer requirement that suppliers may be requested to comply. The IT’s rule creates an exception to compliance, whereas the customer requirement does not permit such exceptions unless explicitly stated.
Analysis: The IT governs the same activity (specific suppliers providing welded components to LEONI) and the customer requirement applies to suppliers in certain Cummins segments. However, the IT explicitly allows non-compliance with ISO-3834 under technical justification and PP approval, which directly contradicts the customer's requirement that suppliers *may be requested* to comply. The IT’s rule creates a pathway for exceptions, while the customer requirement mandates compliance when requested. This is a conflict because the IT permits non-compliance in scenarios where the customer expects compliance.
action: Revise the IT to ensure it mandates compliance with ISO-3834 for specific suppliers when requested by Cummins, without allowing exceptions unless explicitly permitted. Update the rule to align with the customer requirement and remove the authorization for non-compliance under technical justification.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 03-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor pode ser solicitado a cumprir os requisitos de qualidade do padrão ISO-3834 referentes a soldas, se pertencer a determinados segmentos da Cummins Inc.
IT: O QM é responsável por monitorar os fornecedores de segmentos específicos da Cummins Inc., garantindo a conformidade com as normas aplicáveis.
Analysis: Explicit mention of ISO-3834 standard in IT
action: Update IT to specifically reference ISO-3834 compliance for applicable suppliers

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 07-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve receber peças para análise de reclamações de garantia enviadas à Cummins a uma taxa de 30% do volume total de falhas em campo, em média, ao longo de cada período de um ano.
IT: The IT allows return rates below 30% if technically justified, which directly conflicts with the customer's requirement of **at least** 30% (no exceptions).
Analysis: Specific requirement to enforce a minimum return rate of 30% without exceptions (the IT permits lower rates under technical justification, violating the customer’s explicit minimum).
action: Update the IT to explicitly require a **minimum** return rate of 30% for all cases, with no exceptions unless the customer allows deviations. Remove or restrict the QM’s authority to set rates below 30%.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 07-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve receber peças para análise de reclamações de garantia enviadas à Cummins a uma taxa de 30% do volume total de falhas em campo, em média, ao longo de cada período de um ano.
IT: O QM deve determinar o volume de peças a serem devolvidas ao fornecedor com base em critérios técnicos.
Analysis: The specific 30% return rate requirement (customer's exact threshold) is missing from the IT. The IT only references 'technical criteria' without quantifying the rate.
action: Update the IT to explicitly state that the return rate must be 30% of field failure volume annually, aligning with the customer's requirement. Ensure this specific value is included in the relevant rules (e.g., under PR responsibilities).

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 04-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve analisar todas as peças devolvidas e relatar os resultados da análise à Cummins conforme definido na Tabela 1a.
IT: O QM deve garantir que todas as peças devolvidas sejam analisadas e os resultados relatados à Cummins.
Analysis: Reference to Table 1a in the reporting process
action: Update the IT to explicitly include a reference to Table 1a when describing the reporting requirements for Cummins.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 04-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve analisar todas as peças devolvidas e relatar os resultados da análise à Cummins conforme definido na Tabela 1a.
IT: The VCM may choose not to analyze some returned parts, provided that the report is only made for the parts considered critical. This allows exceptions for non-critical parts, conflicting with the requirement to analyze **all** returned parts.
Analysis: The customer requirement mandates that **all** returned parts must be analyzed, with results reported according to Table 1a. The IT allows exceptions by permitting VCM to exclude non-critical parts from analysis (only reporting critical ones). This directly contradicts the requirement's explicit instruction to analyze **all** parts. While the IT governs the same activity (analysis of returned parts), it introduces a conflicting rule that violates the customer’s strict requirement for universal analysis.
action: Revise the IT to remove the exception for non-critical parts and explicitly require analysis of all returned parts, aligning with the customer’s mandate. Ensure reporting follows Table 1a.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 06-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve designar um interlocutor de qualidade, que será o principal canal de comunicação dos requisitos do Manual para a sua organização.
IT: The IT permits any person (non-quality roles) as the contact, whereas the customer requires a dedicated quality contact. This creates a direct contradiction in the role definition and responsibility scope.
Analysis: The customer requirement mandates a dedicated quality contact person for communication purposes. The IT allows any person, including non-quality roles, as the contact. This directly contradicts the requirement's emphasis on a 'dedicated' quality contact. While both address designating a contact, the IT's broad scope (any person) conflicts with the specific need for a quality-focused role. The IT does not enforce the requirement’s specificity, leading to a conflict.
action: Update the IT to explicitly require the designated quality contact to be a dedicated individual from the quality department, ensuring alignment with the customer's requirement for a specialized role.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 05-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve ser notificado pela Cummins sempre que houver uma não conformidade e alertado sobre a necessidade de ação corretiva
IT: A notificação ao fornecedor é uma atividade que será realizada conforme necessário.
Analysis: explicit mention of alerting the supplier about the need for corrective actions
action: Update the IT to explicitly state that suppliers must be alerted about the necessity of corrective actions when non-conformities are detected, aligning with the customer requirement.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 10-CONF
detail:
Requirement: Todas as propostas de alteração no design da embalagem para produtos existentes exigem que o fornecedor reenvie uma Planilha de Dados de Embalagem (PDS) ao gerente de sourcing da Cummins para fins de revisão e aprovação interna.
IT: The IT states: 'A VCM não é obrigada a reenviar o PDS ao gerente de sourcing da Cummins, mas pode submeter uma proposta alternativa para análise do QM.' This rule contradicts the requirement by exempting the mandatory resubmission of the PDS.
Analysis: The obligation to re-submit the PDS to Cummins' sourcing manager for review and approval is explicitly missing from the IT.
action: Update the IT to remove the exemption of PDS resubmission, ensuring compliance with the customer requirement that all design change proposals must include resubmitting the PDS to Cummins' sourcing manager for internal review and approval.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 11-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve notificar Cummins sobre qualquer alteração na estrutura da gestão, dentro de duas semanas após sua implementação.
IT: The IT rule allows a 4-week deadline for notifying Cummins, which **violates** the customer requirement of notifying within 2 weeks. The IT’s stricter (longer) deadline does not satisfy the specific element (deadline) in the requirement.
Analysis: Specific deadline of 2 weeks as required by the customer
action: Update the IT to align with the customer's 2-week deadline for notifying Cummins, ensuring the rule explicitly states 'notificar Cummins em até duas semanas após a efetivação das alterações'.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 11-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve notificar Cummins sobre qualquer alteração na estrutura da gestão, dentro de duas semanas após sua implementação.
IT: O QM é responsável por acompanhar qualquer alteração feita na estrutura da gestão, garantindo que seja comunicada à Cummins em tempo hábil.
Analysis: specific 2-week timeframe requirement
action: Update the IT to explicitly state that notifications must occur **within two weeks** of implementation, aligning with the customer's specific deadline.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 08-CONF does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve analisar peças com falha classificadas como crítica em até 5 dias úteis, sendo que essas devoluções são identificadas claramente.
IT: O QM pode analisar peças com falha classificadas como crítica em um prazo máximo de 7 dias úteis.
Analysis: Specific elements: 5-day deadline for critical failure analysis and mandatory clear identification of returns
action: Update the IT to specify a maximum of 5 working days for critical failure analysis and add a requirement to clearly identify such returns in documentation or systems.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 08-COMP does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve analisar peças com falha classificadas como crítica em até 5 dias úteis, sendo que essas devoluções são identificadas claramente.
IT: O QM deve analisar peças com falha classificadas como crítica dentro do prazo máximo de 5 dias úteis.
Analysis: explicit requirement for clear identification of critical failure returns (devoluções) in documentation or labeling
action: Update the IT to explicitly state that critical failure parts must be clearly marked/identified as such in all relevant records, reports, or systems to meet the customer's 'claramente identificadas' requirement.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 08-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve analisar peças com falha classificadas como crítica em até 5 dias úteis, sendo que essas devoluções são identificadas claramente.
IT: O QM deve analisar peças com falha classificadas como crítica dentro de um prazo razoável.
Analysis: specific 5-day deadline for analysis and explicit communication timing alignment with the requirement
action: Update IT 08-PART to explicitly state a **5-day deadline** for analyzing critical failures and define **communication timing** (e.g., within X days of identification) to align with the customer’s requirement. Ensure 'clearly identified' is addressed through documented procedures in the IT.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 09-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O SQE da Cummins é o principal interlocutor para resolver dúvidas e solucionar problemas em situações não previstas no Manual do Fornecedor.
IT: Em caso de situações não previstas no Manual do Fornecedor, o responsável pela linha de produção deve resolver as dúvidas diretamente com o cliente.
Analysis: IT requires production line to resolve issues directly with customer, conflicting with requirement for SQE to be main interlocutor
action: Revise IT to make SQE the primary contact instead of production line

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 09-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O SQE da Cummins é o principal interlocutor para resolver dúvidas e solucionar problemas em situações não previstas no Manual do Fornecedor.
IT: A VCM regista todas as dúvidas e problemas apresentados ao SQE da Cummins em um formulário específico. O QM acompanha a resolução das questões até à obtenção de uma resposta formal.
Analysis: SQE da Cummins é o principal interlocutor
action: Add explicit statement in IT that SQE is the primary contact, not just recipient of issues.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 12-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor pode utilizar o ISIR, relatório de dimensão e documentos de materiais/desempenho para registrar as declarações de conformidade com os padrões da Cummins durante o PPAP.
IT: The IT restricts VCM to only dimension and performance documents, excluding ISIR, which the customer explicitly allows as part of the required documents.
Analysis: The IT governs the activity of registering compliance declarations in PPAP, as it directly addresses the requirement for suppliers to use specific documents (ISIR, dimension report, performance documents). However, the IT allows QM to use 'other formats' beyond these three, which may include more than what the customer requires. The requirement explicitly permits using all three documents, but the IT restricts VCM to only two (dimension and performance), excluding ISIR. This creates a contradiction because the customer's requirement includes ISIR as an allowed document, while the IT limits VCM's use of it. The IT's broader allowance for QM may cover the requirement, but the restriction on VCM conflicts with the customer's explicit inclusion of ISIR.
action: Update the IT to ensure both QM and VCM can use all three documents (ISIR, dimension report, performance) for compliance declarations in PPAP. Remove the restriction on VCM using ISIR.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 12-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor pode utilizar o ISIR, relatório de dimensão e documentos de materiais/desempenho para registrar as declarações de conformidade com os padrões da Cummins durante o PPAP.
IT: A VCM regista todas as declarações de conformidade em formato digital.
Analysis: ISIR, relatório de dimensão
action: Update the IT to explicitly include the required documents (ISIR, relatório de dimensão) in the list of acceptable materials for compliance declarations during PPAP registration.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 13-COMP
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve notificar imediatamente o gerente de sourcing ou o SQE da Cummins em caso de riscos que possam afetar as entregas ou serviços
IT: The IT allows up to 2 hours for notification, conflicting with the requirement's 'immediately' (no delay).
Analysis: The IT governs exactly the same activity (notifying Cummins of risks affecting deliveries/services) and includes the requirement for immediate notification by QM. However, the IT adds a specific time constraint of 2 hours for notification, which contradicts the customer's 'immediately' requirement. While the IT covers the core action (notification), the explicit deadline in the IT creates a conflict with the customer's expectation of immediacy.
action: Update the IT to remove the 2-hour deadline and ensure notifications are triggered without delay as per the customer requirement.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 13-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve notificar imediatamente o gerente de sourcing ou o SQE da Cummins em caso de riscos que possam afetar as entregas ou serviços
IT: The IT permits a 24-hour delay in notification, which conflicts with the customer's 'immediately' requirement. The IT also allows delays with prior authorization from the purchasing director, which is not addressed in the customer requirement.
Analysis: The same_activity is confirmed: both the customer requirement and the IT govern notifying Cummins about risks affecting deliveries/services. The IT allows a 24-hour delay with prior authorization, which directly contradicts the requirement's 'immediately' mandate. While the IT permits delays under specific conditions, the customer requirement does not allow any exceptions or timeframes. This creates a conflict because the IT’s rule (24-hour delay) violates the requirement’s strict immediacy.
action: Update the IT to remove the 24-hour delay provision and ensure notifications are required to be immediate without exceptions, aligning with the customer's 'immediately' requirement.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 13-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve notificar imediatamente o gerente de sourcing ou o SQE da Cummins em caso de riscos que possam afetar as entregas ou serviços
IT: A notificação deve ser feita com clareza e em tempo hábil, sem especificação de prazo ou destinatários definidos.
Analysis: specific recipients (sourcing manager/SQE) and immediate deadline
action: Update the IT to explicitly define the required recipients (e.g., 'immediately notify Cummins sourcing manager/SQE') and specify the immediacy of the notification (e.g., 'within 24 hours'). Ensure the IT includes exact roles and deadlines as per the customer requirement.
